name: Mitosis
author: Trance
description: A culture under the microscope: a few dozen cells drifting in the slow streaming of the cytoplasm, each dividing in its own time, every eight beats, along an axis of its own. The bass swells them, the mids make their walls quiver and the cymbals light the nuclei; the streaming itself is drawn faintly underneath.

layers.code:
c = floor(n/2)
side = mod(n, 2)*2 - 1
q = beats/8 + c*0.37
p = fract(q)
th = noise(c*3.1, floor(q))*tau*2
sep = smoothstep(0.35, 0.9, p)
r0 = 0.09 + 0.05*noise(c*1.7, 4)
px = (noise(c*2.3, time*0.03) - 0.5)*3.4
py = (noise(c*4.1 + 9, time*0.03) - 0.5)*2
x = px + side*sep*r0*0.85*cos(th)
y = py + side*sep*r0*0.85*sin(th)
f = smoothstep(0, 0.08, p)*(1 - smoothstep(0.92, 1, p))
radius = r0*(1 - 0.25*sep) + 0.012*min(bass_att, 2) + 0.005*sin(time*3 + n)*min(mid_att, 2)
a = 0.3*f
a2 = 0.8*f
